FacilityId.description: Value of a facility identifier in a selection.

FacilityIssues.description:
Handling of facilities outside the grid, on a barrier or without a
usable geometry.

oneOf.description: Fail validation, listing every problem facility.
Skip them and list them in the warnings.

ids.description:
Optional selection: only the facilities whose `id_field` value is
listed, combined with `where`. Every listed identifier must exist.

layer.description: Layer name; the first layer when omitted.

where.description:
Optional OGR SQL attribute filter selecting facilities, e.g.
`"type = 'hospital'"`; all features when omitted.

oneOf.description: Scenario speed only; slope and mode ignored.
Mobility model with slope and transport mode.

MobilityModel.description:
Named, frozen mobility model. Any change to an equation or constant
creates a new variant; existing variants never change.

Neighbourhood.description: Neighbours reachable in one step: 8 (cardinal and diagonal) or 16 (plus knight moves).

speed_kmh.description:
Flat-ground speed, km/h, ≥ 0 (≤ 100 for bicycling); 0 makes the
class a barrier, as AccessMod 5 scenarios do.

SearchFrom.description: Which side referral searches start from.

oneOf.description:
The smaller side; from the destinations (slopes inverted) when there
are fewer of them. Times then equal forward searches up to
floating-point summation order (relative 1e-15).
Always the origins: exact forward searches.

TransportMode.description: Transport mode of a land-cover class in a scenario.

oneOf.description: Physical cycling model with a downhill safety envelope (LUT).

dem.description: Digital elevation model; it defines the grid.

destinations.description: Facilities travel goes to (may be the same layer as the origins).

facility_issues.description: What to do with facilities outside the grid or on a barrier.

land_cover.description: Land-cover raster with integer classes, on the DEM lattice.

limit_s.description: Inclusive travel-time limit, seconds; pairs beyond are not reached.

nearest_only.description: Only the nearest destination (by time) of each origin.

neighbourhood.description: Neighbours reachable in one step: 8 or 16.

output_dir.description: Output directory; must not exist or be empty.

scenario.description: Mobility of each land-cover class. Classes not listed are barriers.

search_from.description:
Which side searches start from: `auto` (the smaller side, equal to
forward searches up to floating-point rounding) or `origins` (exact
forward searches).

self_pairs.description:
Keep pairs from a facility to itself (same FID of the same layer);
AccessMod 5 drops them.
